title: Even Harvest Total
description: A farmer logs the weight of each harvested crate. Only crates with an **even** weight can be sold at the market. Compute the total weight of the sellable crates.
inputFormat: The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers `w1 ... wn`.
outputFormat: Print the sum of all even weights.
hints: Look at each weight exactly once.
A number is even when x % 2 == 0 (careful with negative numbers in some languages).
Keep a running 64-bit total of the even values.
approach: Scan the weights once and add every even value to a 64-bit accumulator. The sum can reach 10^14, so 32-bit integers overflow.

solutionCode:
import sys

d = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(d[0])
print(sum(x for x in map(int, d[1:1 + n]) if x % 2 == 0))
